name: kori
description: Read and edit your Kori grocery lists from a chat.

interface.longDescription:
Kori is a grocery list app for people who shop together. With this connector you can look at your Kori lists, add items, check them off as you shop, put them back, change a quantity, unit, note or category, and remove items you added and no longer need. It can also suggest items from your purchase history, create a new list, and set up the account for a new Kori user.

It works only with the Kori account you sign in with, and only with the lists that account is a member of. You need a Kori account and sign in with it when asked. The connector does not place orders or take payments.
defaultPrompt: What is on my grocery list?
Add milk and bread to my list.

positive.description: List the user's lists and read one
positive.prompt: What is on my grocery list?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the user's lists, then the items of the grocery list with the items still to buy first.

positive.description: Add items, using suggestions from purchase history
positive.prompt: What am I probably running low on? Add the first two to my grocery list.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the suggested items with a reason for each, then adds the first two to the grocery list and reports that they were added.

positive.description: Check items off, put one back and change a quantity
positive.prompt: I have the milk and the bread in my basket. Actually, put the bread back, and make it 3 loaves.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks off the milk and the bread, puts the bread back on the list to buy, and sets the bread quantity to 3.

positive.prompt: Remove the eggs from my grocery list.
positive.expected_behavior: Removes the eggs from the list and reports the removed item with its title and quantity.

positive.description: Set up a new account and create a list
positive.prompt: Set up my Kori account in English, then create a list called Weekend barbecue.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets up the account in English if it has no list yet, then creates the Weekend barbecue list and returns its id.

negative.description: Kori does not place orders or deliver groceries, so it should not act
negative.prompt: Order these groceries for delivery to my home.

negative.description: Kori cannot delete an account, so it should not act
negative.prompt: Delete my Kori account and everything in it.

negative.description: Kori only manages grocery lists, so a recipe request is outside its scope and it should not act
negative.prompt: Write me a three-course dinner menu for eight guests with cooking times.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read and edit your Kori grocery lists from ChatGPT: see your lists, add items, check items off and put them back, change an item's quantity, unit, note or category, remove items you added, get suggestions from your purchase history, create a list, and set up a new Kori account.
